final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT zc.city, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN zip_code zc ON m.zip = zc.zip_code GROUP BY zc.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) as share FROM city_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val FROM city_shares), filtered AS (SELECT city, cnt, share, (share - (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share)) as excess FROM city_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share)) SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered
